title: Dera Ghazi Khan Development Authority Repeal Act 2017

sections.shortTitle: Dera Ghazi Khan Development Authority Repeal Act 2017
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

ACT XVIII OF 2017
ACT XVIII OF 2017
DERA GHAZI KHAN DEVELOPMENT AUTHORITY
(REPEAL) ACT, 2017
An Act to repeal the Dera Ghazi Khan Development
Authority Act, 1991
[Gazette of Punjab Extraordinary,
8th November, 2017]
No.
PAP/Legis-2(167)/2017/1670, dated 8.11.2017.---The Dera Ghazi
Khan Development Authority (Repeal) Bill 2017, having been passed by the
Provincial Assembly of the Punjab on October 25, 2017, and assented to by the
Governor of the Punjab on October 30, 2017, is hereby published as an Act of
the Provincial Assembly of the Punjab.
It is necessary to repeal the Dera Ghazi Khan Development
Authority Act, 1991 (VI of 1991) so that Dera Ghazi Khan Development Authority
may be constituted under the provisions of the Development of Cities Act 1976
comparable with the Authorities constituted in many other cities of the Punjab
inter alia for orderly and planned growth of the city of Dera Ghazi Khan.
Be it enacted by the Provincial Assembly of the Punjab as
follows:
1. Short title and
commencement.---This Act may be cited as the Dera Ghazi Khan
Development Authority (Repeal) Act, 2017.
(2) It shall come
into force at once.

PAP/Legis-2(167)/2017/1670, dated 8.11.2017.---The Dera Ghazi
Khan Development Authority (Repeal) Bill 2017, having been passed by the

Be it enacted by the Provincial Assembly of the Punjab as

3. Savings.---Notwithstanding
repeal of the Dera Ghazi Khan Development Authority Act, 1991 (VI of 1991), any
rules, regulations or appointments made, orders passed, notifications issued,
contracts entered into, proceedings commenced, rights acquired, liabilities
incurred, penalties, rates, fees or charges levied, things done or action taken
under penalties, rates, fees or charges levied, things done or action taken
under any provisions of the repealed Act shall continue to have effect unless
repealed, recalled, withdrawn or cancelled.
